program_solutions:
(rule!
  (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
    (lambda (r c)
      (let ((up (= (safe-at g (- r 1) c 0) 3))
            (down (= (safe-at g (+ r 1) c 0) 3))
            (left (= (safe-at g r (- c 1) 0) 3))
            (right (= (safe-at g r (+ c 1) 0) 3)))
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 3)
                 (= (count-where identity (list up down left right)) 2)
                 (or up down)
                 (or left right))
            6
            (at g r c))))))
